name: literature-review
description: A closed-evidence literature review assistant for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, extract, synthesize, and audit source-grounded literature reviews.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin for closed-evidence literature reviews using user-provided sources. It helps frame the review, register sources, create matrices, extract evidence, synthesize themes, draft APA-style report chapters, and audit citation traceability.
defaultPrompt: Run a literature review from my PDFs.
Create review matrices for this project.
Audit citations in my review draft.
